title: Base Jack & Collar Alignment
description: Heavy-duty base jacks anchored to engineered ground footings. Initial spindle adjustment guarantees 0.1° plumb line tolerance across irregular terrain.

title: Vertical Standard Insertion
description: Vertical standards fitted into base collars. Patented 8-hole rosette discs position at exact 500mm vertical increments.

title: Ledger Placement & Wedge Lock
description: Horizontal ledgers connected at 90° intervals. Hammer blow engages captive wedge into rosette disc, securing rigid unyielding joint.

title: Diagonal Spatial Bracing
description: Diagonal braces attached across alternate bays to establish triangulation and eliminate sway during high-elevation loads.

title: Anti-Tilt Steel Planks
description: Perforated galvanized steel decks locked directly onto ledger profiles with integrated wind-lift security catches.

title: Internal Access Trapdoors & Ladders
description: Integrated aluminum inclined stairways or trapdoor decks installed to guarantee safe internal operative passage.

title: Advanced Guardrails & Toe Boards
description: Dual-tier guardrails and perimeter steel toe boards mounted before operatives step onto upper levels, achieving zero-fall risk.
